# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free Australian sole trader tax calculator: enter income and expenses to see income tax, Medicare levy, optional HELP repayment and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/au-sole-trader-tax-set-aside-calculator/)
